reviews.text: I am so happy with the work that Fences and More LLC did for my home. My fence looks great and I get compliments from my neighbors very often. I would highly recommend this company. Great customer service as well.
reviews.author: C Presley

reviews.text: This was my first home renovation project with Fences and More LLC and the experience was outstanding from start to finish! Joesph and his crew were professional, transparent, and made the whole process stress-free. Joseph communicated clearly, stayed on schedule, and the quality of work exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend them for anyone doing any home renovations! I definitely will use and refer them.
reviews.author: Derick Singleton

reviews.text: I had some quick work that was needed at my home and Fences and More LLC were quick to get the job done. Joseph was available to answer any of my questions throughout the process and the work was done professionally and efficiently. I will absolutely use them in the future.
reviews.author: Simonne Bailey

reviews.text: I used Fences and More LLC to power-wash and paint our shed.  Joseph responded quickly and was very knowledgeable.  He explained clearly what needed to be done and followed through as expected.  Will hire again.
reviews.author: Beth Harcourt

reviews.text: Joe built us a new fence with electric driveway gate and patio cover. He was honest and up front and communicated with us throughout the whole process. Results were better than I expected. Fence and patio look great.
reviews.author: Brian G

data.summary: The reviews show signs of potential inauthenticity due to their uniformly perfect, generic nature, short timeframe, and low volume. While the projects mentioned vary, the language is repetitive and lacks the specific details, minor criticisms, or emotional authenticity typical of genuine customer experiences. The high ratings are consistent but based on a very small sample size that raises suspicion.
fake_signals: All sampled reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Reviews are clustered in a short timeframe (2-4 months)
Generic, repetitive praise lacking specific project details
Owner's name (Joseph/Joe) repeated in a formulaic way
Low total review count (7 on each platform) for an established contractor
authentic_signals: Different reviewer names and writing styles
Mention of varied project types (fence, gate, patio cover, power-washing)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are high and consistent across the two primary review platforms (Google and Yelp).
